Search public torrent indexers and download what you find, without leaving the terminal. One binary, no runtime to install. Downloads run in the background while you keep searching, finished downloads seed until you stop them, and every setting lives on one page inside the interface.
4gray.iptvnator: A video player application that provides support for the playback of IPTV playlists (m3u, m3u8).

IPTVnator is a video player application that provides support for IPTV playlist playback (m3u, m3u8). The application allows users to import playlists using remote URLs or by uploading files from the local file system. Additionally, it supports EPG information in XMLTV format which can be provided via URL.
The application is a cross-platform, open-source project built with Electron and Angular.
⚠️ Note: IPTVnator does not provide any playlists or other digital content. The channels and pictures in the screenshots are for demonstration purposes only.

4Worlds.Inkwell: A portable, offline-first Markdown editor with live preview, Typst PDF export, and SQLite persistence.

Inkwell is a lightweight, offline-first Markdown editor built for focused writing. No cloud, no accounts, no telemetry.
Features include split-view live preview, command palette, 4 built-in themes plus a custom theme creator, Mermaid
diagrams, KaTeX math, workspace file tree, find & replace, typewriter mode, focus mode, file tabs, templates,
version history with diff viewer, file association handling, auto-save on focus loss, and SQLite-backed persistence.
Typst-powered PDF export and standalone HTML export are unlocked with a one-time Pro license.
Part of the 4Worlds anti-SaaS portable app suite.
